text: In Grafana, create a NEW dashboard (Dashboards menu > New dashboard > Add visualization, or the + Create > Dashboard button). First, if the new dashboard opens with a default panel editor, set the visualization type to Stat and set the panel title to exactly: fwgr81-n1 Availability. For the panel's data source / query, select the data source named TestData (it may be called 'TestData DB' or 'grafana-testdata-datasource' — pick the TestData one). Configure the query so it returns data (e.g. the default scenario is fine, such as 'Random Walk' or 'Current Time' — whatever the TestData source defaults to). Apply the panel. Then save the dashboard with the title exactly: fwgr81-n1 Bench Dashboard (use the save icon / Save dashboard shortcut, enter the title, and confirm Save). Verify the dashboard is saved (no unsaved-changes indicator) and report the dashboard's URL from the browser address bar, the panel title shown, and the data source name used by the panel.

summary: Navigated to the plain URL http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efzg5dwxmaayof/fwgr81-n1-bench-dashboard; Grafana immediately rewrote the address bar with the dashboard's saved defaults, and reading the location verbatim gave: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efzg5dwxmaayof/fwgr81-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m. (a) Header/breadcrumb title: "fwgr81-n1 Bench Dashboard". (b) Panel titles: "fwgr81-n1 Notes" (Text panel displaying "Bench notes for run fwgr81-n1") and "fwgr81-n1 Availability" (Stat panel, rendering A-series 60.6). (c) Time range control: "Last 6 hours". (d) Refresh interval control: "1m". (e) Opened dashboard Settings (gear) — the Tags field shows the single tag, exposed on the page as the chip labelled 'Remove "bench" tag'; I closed settings via "Back to dashboard" and exited edit mode without saving. Nothing was modified: the toolbar is back in view mode (Edit/Share/Mark as favorite present, no Add/Settings/Save dashboard/Exit edit) and no unsaved-changes state was left behind. (time_range_control: aria-label: "Time range selected: Last 6 hours") (refresh_interval_control: aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected")
